concept.concept: Black canvas tote with orange spiderweb illustration and 'Official Candy Collector' in retro horror font
concept.audience: Parents buying for young children and adults doing ironic trick-or-treat gatherings
concept.rationale: Halloween totes for trick-or-treating are a top seasonal seller. Functional product with clear use case. Buying window is perfect — 6-7 weeks before Halloween. Both sincere and ironic audiences exist. Design is simple to produce and highly giftable.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Official Candy Collector" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a bold geometric spiderweb with a stylized spider perched at center. Orange spiderweb lines with sharp angles and clean geometric geometry on solid black background. Single centered composition with generous margins. Screen-print aesthetic with solid color blocks, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. High contrast, readable at 12x16 inches from across a room. Color palette: orange, black, cream. The artwork connects as one unified design element, positioned away from edges.
design.style: Bold retro horror serif font arched above the spiderweb illustration, cream colored text, all caps, 1970s horror movie poster aesthetic

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Official Candy Collector' is a generic Halloween-themed expression with no known trademark associations. The spiderweb illustration is a common public domain Halloween motif. The retro horror font style is a broad aesthetic category. No celebrity, brand, character, or protected slogan is referenced. The overall concept is original seasonal novelty merchandise with low IP risk.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly 'Official Candy Collector' correctly spelled across three lines, with clean bold typography. The orange spider and spiderweb graphic is a generic Halloween motif with no IP concerns. Text is fully legible, well-rendered, and suitable for garment printing on a solid black background.

listing.title: Official Candy Collector Spiderweb Tote - Halloween Trick-or-Treat Bag
listing.description: Black canvas tote featuring orange spiderweb illustration and 'Official Candy Collector' in retro horror font. Perfect for young children on Halloween night or adults participating in ironic trick-or-treat gatherings. Durable construction handles candy collection and everyday use. Works as party favor, gift bag, or seasonal decoration storage. Ideal present for parents, trick-or-treaters, and anyone hosting Halloween events. Celebrate the season with retro-inspired humor and functionality.
